title: [DT] : UI/UX Designer
description:
**Job Description – UI/UX Designer**
------------------------------------

**Position:** UI/UX Designer
**Experience:** 3–5 Years
**Location:** Noida
**Industry:** IT / Software Development### **About the Role**


We are looking for a creative and user\-focused **UI/UX Designer with 3–5 years of experience** to design intuitive, engaging, and visually appealing digital experiences. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **UX research, wireframing, prototyping, UI design, and design systems**, with the ability to collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, and other stakeholders.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Understand business requirements, user needs, and product objectives to create effective design solutions.
* Conduct **user research, competitor analysis, and usability analysis** where required.
* Create **user flows, information architecture, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes**.
* Design responsive and user\-friendly interfaces for **web and mobile applications**.
* Develop and maintain **UI design systems, reusable components, and design guidelines**.
* Convert complex business requirements into simple and intuitive user experiences.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Conduct usability testing and incorporate feedback into designs.
* Ensure consistency in typography, colors, layouts, interactions, and visual hierarchy.
* Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs.
* Review implemented designs and provide UI/UX feedback to maintain design quality.
* Stay updated with current **UI/UX trends, design patterns, accessibility standards, and emerging tools**.

### **Required Skills**

* 3–5 years of professional experience in **UI/UX Design**.
* Strong proficiency in **Figma** is mandatory.
* Good knowledge of:
	+ Wireframing
	+ Prototyping
	+ User flows
	+ Information architecture
	+ Usability testing
	+ Interaction design
	+ Visual/UI design
	+ Design systems
* Experience designing **responsive web applications and mobile applications**.
* Strong understanding of **HTML/CSS limitations and frontend development concepts**.
* Good understanding of responsive design and cross\-platform design principles.
* Knowledge of **UX research methodologies** and usability principles.
* Understanding of **accessibility and WCAG guidelines** is an advantage.
* Strong visual design skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience working on **SaaS / B2B / Enterprise applications**.
* Experience with **Design Systems and component libraries**.
* Familiarity with **Adobe Creative Suite / Photoshop / Illustrator**.
* Basic understanding of **HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or other frontend technologies**.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum environments**.
* Exposure to AI\-powered design/prototyping tools is a plus.

title: 4689- Senior Product Designer
description:
**About the team**


Innovaccer builds AI agents for healthcare that automate administrative work, so care teams can get back to care. As a Lead Product Designer, you'll design the interfaces and workflows that make that autonomy usable, trustworthy, and clear for the organizations who rely on it. This is an individual contributor role. You’ll independently own complex design projects, work closely with product and engineering, and contribute to the quality of the broader product and design team.


**Product Management at Innovaccer**


The Product team at Innovaccer designs AI\-native solutions for healthcare providers, payers, and government organizations: agentic workflows that automate complex clinical and operational processes, intelligent systems that replace manual work at scale, and data infrastructure that makes all of it possible. Every product decision here is a bet on what AI\-native healthcare infrastructure needs to look like next, positioning Innovaccer as the autonomous operations platform leader.


If you think in systems, work well with ambiguity, and want your output to have real stakes, this team is where you will do your best work.

 **Requirements** **Own the product experience \-**

Lead design end to end for a product


Design data\-dense, high\-stakes clinical and operational workflows


Design AI\-assisted workflows where users feel in control


Choose the medium that best solves the problem, including Figma, Claude Code, etc


Use AI throughout the design process


Partner with product and engineering from exploration through implementation


Review, iterate, improve


**Contribute to the craft**

Start with existing components and patterns, extending them deliberately when needed


Contribute reusable components, interaction patterns, and documentation


Build modular experiences that work across products, use cases, and users


Partner with design\-system and front\-end teams to maintain consistency


**Drive the product**

Advocate for the user


Plan and conduct generative and evaluative research independently


Favor small, testable releases that create learning over large design changes


Shape product’s roadmap and goals


What You'll Need
Experience owning complex products from ambiguous problems to impact


Strong instincts, taste, and care for detail


Comfortable across design mediums: Figma, Paper, Claude Code, or similar


You are a systems thinker who can zoom out and see parts and the whole


You have worked with and contributed to a mature design system


You have mentored designers through influence rather than authority


Design is good communication. You should be able to communicate effectively


3\+ years of industry experience designing solutions for web, mobile, and desktop

**Nice to have**

Experience designing complex B2B or enterprise software


Experience with AI\-assisted, agentic, or probabilistic products


Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain


Comfort using product analytics to inform design decisions


Experience building functional prototypes with code or AI\-assisted development tools


Experience shipping products with small, cross\-functional teams


Writing or speaking publicly about design

  

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

 **Benefits**  

Here's What We Offer


* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet\-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends to the office. \*Noida office only
* Creche Facility for children\*: A convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well\-being first. \*India offices

Where and how we work


Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five\-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.


Innovaccer is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.


Disclaimer: Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR


department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.


About Innovaccer


Innovaccer Inc. is the data platform that accelerates innovation. The Innovaccer platform unifies patient data across systems and care settings, and empowers healthcare organizations with scalable, modern applications that improve clinical, financial, operational, and experiential outcomes. Innovaccer’s EHR\-agnostic solutions have been deployed across more than 1,600


hospitals and clinics in the US, enabling care delivery transformation for more than 96,000 clinicians, and helping providers work collaboratively with payers and life sciences companies.


Innovaccer has helped its customers unify health records for more than 54 million people and generate over $1\.5 billion in cumulative cost savings. The Innovaccer platform is the \#1 rated Best\-in\-KLAS data and analytics platform by KLAS, and the \#1 rated population health technology platform by Black Book. For more information, please visit innovaccer.com.


Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, and innovaccer.com.

description:

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer with 2–4 years of professional experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, a deep understanding of UI/UX principles, and hands\-on experience designing modern, intuitive, and user\-friendly digital products using Figma.

You will work closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to design engaging user experiences for websites, mobile applications, dashboards, and other digital products.

* Design responsive websites, landing pages, mobile applications, dashboards, and web applications.
* Develop and maintain reusable design systems, components, and style guides.
* Ensure consistency in typography, colors, spacing, and overall visual design.
* Collaborate closely with developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation.
* Conduct competitor analysis and contribute to improving user experience.
* Iterate and improve designs based on feedback, usability testing, and business requirements.
* Organize and maintain Figma files, libraries, and components.
* Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and best practices.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or Product Designer.
* Strong proficiency in Figma.
* Excellent understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and accessibility.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and interactive user flows.
* Strong knowledge of design systems and reusable components.
* Good understanding of typography, color theory, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience collaborating with developers and cross\-functional teams.
* Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and FigJam is preferred.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and time management skills.

**Portfolio Requirement**

Candidates must share their portfolio along with their application.

**The portfolio should demonstrate:**

* Websites, mobile apps, dashboards, or SaaS products
* Wireframes and prototypes
* High\-fidelity UI designs
* Design systems or component libraries (preferred)

**Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.**

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on exciting real\-world digital products.
